steps.title: Meet Kaju
steps.narration: Kaju runs Kaju Garments in Tiruppur: polo and round-neck T-shirts. 34 enquiries in 90 days, but he replies to only 40%. Leads are slipping away.

steps.title: Same seller, two openings
steps.narration: Today's VANI opens cold and pitches. Meera opens with what Kaju asked for last time.
steps.cold: Namaste, main IndiaMART se bol rahi hoon. Aap kya bechte hain?

steps.title: What Meera remembers about Kaju
steps.narration: A callback he asked for, buyer enquiries he hasn't read, a catalog photo stuck on WhatsApp. Three open threads, ranked.

steps.title: Raju's requirement reaches Kaju
steps.narration: Raju's 500-piece Polo lead is matched to Kaju. One event, two memories. Watch what crosses the firewall and what doesn't.

steps.title: Meera calls Kaju
steps.narration: Meera calls Kaju with the fresh lead. He asks for the buyer's number, and Meera refuses. He commits to a quote.
suggest: Buyer ka number do, main khud baat kar lunga
Theek hai, kal 11 baje tak polo ka quote bhej dunga

turns: Namaste ji, Kaju Garments se baat ho rahi hai? Aapne dobara call karne ko kaha tha, isliye call kiya hai. Aur Delhi se Polo T-Shirt ki fresh requirement bhi aayi hai.
Haan boliye. Buyer ka number do, main khud baat kar lunga.
Ji, buyer ki personal details main share nahi kar sakti. Aap quote dijiye, main IndiaMART ke through unhe bhej deti hoon. Quote kab tak bhejenge?
Theek hai, kal 11 baje tak polo T-shirt ka quote bhej dunga.
Ji, kal 11 baje tak ka quote note kar liya. Dhanyavaad.

platform_vars.next_step: Send Polo T-shirt quote by 11 AM tomorrow

steps.title: Beyond the bot
steps.narration: An IndiaMART executive opens Kaju's card before dialling. Same memory, read by heading. No AI involved.

steps.title: What's underneath
steps.narration: Two API calls. Any IndiaMART bot (VANI, WhatsApp, CRM) gets memory by reading context at the start and posting events at the end.
